name: rarity-ig-captions
title_zh: 配图不重述画面，专写让人停指头的那行开场
tagline_zh: 图已经说了 headline，就别让文案再说一遍。它专攻被折叠前那两行——用打断惯性的话钩住拇指。
tagline_en: Your art already says the headline—so this writes the part that survives truncation. Pattern-interrupt openers.
